summary: Re-verified all three previously reported responsive issues in About/Experience/Hero sections. All fixes confirmed working across mobile (375), tablet (768) and desktop (1920) viewports.
critical_code_review_comments: All three issues from iteration_1 (card overlap, tablet ellipsis truncation, 26px horizontal scroll) are confirmed FIXED.
About.jsx stat cards use 'text-lg sm:text-xl lg:text-3xl font-bold leading-tight' with no truncate class — text renders in full at every breakpoint.

index.css correctly applies overflow-x:hidden on both html and body; App.js root has overflow-x-hidden class — document.documentElement.scrollWidth equals innerWidth at all tested viewports (375, 768, 1920).
Experience timeline dots on mobile positioned at left ~24px (within viewport) — no longer causing overflow.
Hero 'Prajwal' heading fits on mobile at 36px (text-4xl).
